children: Coal India Ltd. (NSE:COALINDIA) reported strong FY26 output and profits across the group and subsidiaries while rising September auction premiums and planned stake sales (IIFCL IPO, MCL/SECL disinvestments) could lift receipts even as power-plant coal stocks eased in October.

: Coal India (COALINDIA) FY26: group production 768.19 MT, revenue Rs 1,68,400 crore, consolidated PAT Rs 31,071 crore. MCL output 218.31 MT (PAT Rs 10,698 crore); SECL 176.29 MT (PAT Rs 4,755 crore).
: Disinvestment plans mention Coal India Ltd. (COALINDIA): an IIFCL IPO raising proceeds for the Centre and stake sales in MCL and SECL that may boost Coal India’s receipts and affect FY28 dividend.
: Coal India (COALINDIA) ran evacuation and redistribution as domestic power-plant coal stocks eased to 18.205 MT on Oct 10 from 18.932 MT on Sep 29; depletion slowed in October.
: Coal India Ltd. (COALINDIA) subsidiaries sold coal at September auctions with an average premium of 94% over notified prices, up from 59% in August, showing rising auction premiums.
: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund held Coal India Ltd. (COALINDIA) unchanged in September 2026, reporting no buys or sells and keeping its position static for the period.
